title: NUERS Developer API
description: Implemented NUERS application routes. This is not an official BIR EIS API specification. Live BIR transport remains unavailable.

endpoints.title: API health
endpoints.description: Basic application response. This is not database, queue or BIR gateway health.

endpoints.title: Accept a finalized source event
endpoints.description: Atomic tenant-bound financial intake, current prepaid wallet fee, active live key, exact branch/IP, shared quotas and taxpayer issuance gates.

fields.name: external_reference
fields.description: Stable source reference, up to 120 characters. Duplicate lookup is scoped to the API key’s merchant.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: PHP units, >= 0. Required when gross_amount is absent.

fields.name: gross_amount
fields.description: PHP units, >= 0. Required when amount is absent; takes precedence if both are sent.

fields.name: vat_rate
fields.description: Supported tax rate, 0 or 12 according to tax treatment; server rejects inconsistent taxes.

fields.name: vat_inclusive
fields.description: Defaults to true. For VAT-exclusive input, VAT is added to the supplied amount.

fields.name: payment_method
fields.description: Maximum 80 characters; defaults to cash. Payment metadata is separate from BIR acceptance.

fields.name: document_type
fields.description: vat_invoice | non_vat_invoice | vat_exempt_invoice | zero_rated_invoice | mixed_sales_invoice | payment_receipt | sales_invoice | official_receipt. These are NUERS identifiers, not a legal classification ruling.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: Up to 255 characters; omit in synthetic examples. Real data requires authorized handling.

fields.name: customer_tin
fields.description: Optional supported 9/12/14-digit TIN form; field validation is not BIR verification.

fields.name: branch_code
fields.description: Exact five-digit BIR branch code authorized by the key.

fields.name: receipt_number
fields.description: Original finalized source number; must match the next configured authorized series.

fields.name: items
fields.description: 1–100 complete item lines. description, positive quantity, unit_price in PHP/pesos and supported tax treatment; server reconciles lines and gross total.

fields.name: source_event_id
fields.description: Stable source event ID, up to 120 characters.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: invoice.finalized | payment.recorded. Payment evidence is not another sale.

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.description: Original event timestamp with explicit timezone; preserve on every retry.

notes: Example fee is illustrative; read GET /api/integrations/transactions/wallet for the current platform fee. API money input is PHP/pesos; wallet amounts are integer centavos.
The merchant comes from the key. Sandbox keys cannot write financial records.
Exact identity/content replay returns 200 and the original response without another fee. Conflicting content under an existing identity returns 409. Preserve original event ID, timestamp and number.

402 returns code=INSUFFICIENT_WALLET_BALANCE, available_centavos, required_centavos, shortage_centavos and transaction_saved=false. No financial record, debit or numbering advance commits. Retain the source on the client and retry the same identity after funding.

The fee applies once per eligible finalized primary sale of PHP500 or above. Smaller sales, payment copies and accepted retries do not add a sale fee. Funding does not bypass branch, tax, series, authority or BIR delivery gates.

endpoints.title: Current business account
endpoints.description: Retrieve the business linked to the authenticated user. Use the user session token, not a merchant integration key.

endpoints.title: List merchant transactions
endpoints.description: Tenant-scoped transaction list and recorded summaries.

endpoints.title: List merchant API keys
endpoints.description: List masked key metadata for the authenticated merchant. Stored plaintext keys are not returned.

endpoints.title: Create merchant API key
endpoints.description: Create a tenant-bound machine credential. The response contains plain_key once; store it in approved secret storage.

fields.name: environment
fields.description: live | sandbox. Label alone is not sandbox isolation.

fields.name: scopes
fields.description: Explicit scope strings; transactions:write is required for transaction ingestion.

fields.name: ip_whitelist
fields.description: Exact source IP strings. CIDR matching is not implemented in ingestion.

notes: User-session authorization and an existing merchant association are required. This operation creates access; the public sandbox does not execute it.
Key management is available through the merchant API-key dashboard. Never paste a real key into the public sandbox.

endpoints.title: Update merchant API key policy
endpoints.description: Update permitted metadata and access policy for an owned key. No rotate flag is implemented.

fields.name: active
fields.description: true enables; false makes the owned key inactive.

notes: For replacement: create a new key, update authorized consumers, verify readiness and then revoke the old key. There is no atomic rotate endpoint.

endpoints.title: Revoke a merchant API key
endpoints.description: Deactivate an owned API key through the controlled key-management route.
notes: This changes access. The documentation and public sandbox never execute it automatically.

endpoints.title: EIS readiness
endpoints.description: Inspect recorded accreditation/taxpayer gates, checks and queue metadata. Authorized roles: admin, super_admin, bir.

production_blockers: Verified BIR production transport is not implemented.

notes: Local readiness and registered credentials do not constitute BIR approval.

endpoints.title: Validate internal EIS payload
endpoints.description: Validate the current NUERS structural payload requirements and return its canonical hash and deadline. This is not official BIR schema conformance.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Object or JSON string. Current checker requires a document identifier, parseable issue/transaction date, Philippine-format seller TIN and a positive total.

warnings: Digital signature hash is not present yet; production transmission must be signed.

notes: Default timezone/display rules and the actual returned due_at govern this internal check. The example is dated and illustrative.
Validation does not create a document, transmit it or establish tax correctness.

endpoints.title: Queue certification payload
endpoints.description: Record an eligible internal transmission intent. Certification requires payload.is_test=true; production is blocked until the separate authority and transport gates pass.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Internal EIS payload. Use explicit synthetic test data only in certification.

notes: This endpoint writes queue and audit records. The public sandbox does not call it.
Document identity includes seller, branch, document type and number within an environment. Same identity/hash returns the original; changed content is rejected with 409.
A queued or simulated certification acknowledgment is not BIR acceptance.

endpoints.title: List recorded transmissions
endpoints.description: Search recorded queue states and attempts.

endpoints.title: Run an isolated contract preview
endpoints.description: Validate synthetic transaction fields using the same shared NUERS field rules/calculation service. No financial database writes or BIR network requests.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Required for validate/preview. external_reference must start TEST-, DEMO- or SAMPLE-. No credentials or private keys.

fields.name: scenario
fields.description: For scenario: duplicate | conflict | unauthorized | forbidden | rate_limit | timeout | production_gate.

notes: Actual HTTP 200 carries simulated_http_status for a scenario. It does not emit a real API 401/429 or authorize retry against a production system.
20 requests/minute per limiter identity; 64 KB maximum request size; preview amount maximum PHP 1 billion.
No Authorization or X-NUERS-API-Key header is accepted. Synthetic customer TIN, if used, must be 999999999000.

endpoints.title: Read prepaid funds and current fee
endpoints.description: transactions:read scope. Shared merchant balance, current pricing revision and client intake preference. No wallet funding or BIR connection is performed.

endpoints.title: Accept a finalized source batch atomically
endpoints.description: transactions:write, active live key. One branch, 1–50 original source events using the finalized event contract. New financial events, numbering and all fees commit together or none commit.

fields.name: events
fields.description: 1–50 complete NUERS-ingestion-1 events; use original legal source order.

notes: A failed batch returns 402 if the total fee for new eligible events exceeds available funds. Existing exact duplicates require no new fee. Any validation, authority, sequence or source conflict rejects the entire batch. Retain every unaccepted original on the client.
Batches are limited to 10 requests/minute plus key admission budgets. These are protective limits, not measured throughput.
Client preference can be realtime or batch. External POS/ERP connectors must implement the preference, durable source retention and bounded identical retries.
